· MACD histogram trajectory (0.2797→-0.1601): shifting from bearish convergence to worsening, suggesting further downside pressure.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $261.50): approaching lower band, oversold pressure.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($276.92): key support level near the 52-week low.
· Swing resistance ($291.59): first resistance zone for any short-term rebound.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: 5-day low ($272.36) similar to 20-day low ($272.36), possibility of Lower Low pattern continuation.

· Current phase diagnosis: within a downtrend, entering oversold territory; short-term rebound possible but trend reversal confirmation needed. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
